unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #173 asking SatGate to add Nano (XNO) to the set of rails its firewall abstracts. SatGate tagline "capabilities in, receipts out, rails abstracted" - argued the public Nano block IS the receipt their verify() wants, and no coin-gas means no funding route before an agent can pay. Canon line: a balance in someone elses database is a receivable, not revenue. Referenced Vend paypercall.dev.
